system.boundary: Build a closed-loop lumped-parameter cardiovascular model coupled to a pulsatile left-ventricular assist device (LVAD).
engineering_objects: The cardiovascular plant shall include four cardiac chambers with time-varying elastance, one-way cardiac valves, systemic and pulmonary vascular compartments, and pressure/volume state dynamics.
The assist device shall include filling and ejection dynamics and shall exchange flow with the cardiovascular plant rather than prescribing an output waveform.
Each mode must act on the corresponding connected plant or feedback path and may not merely relabel an output.
physical_paths: Read these scalar mode inputs from the MATLAB base workspace: CardiacConditionMode (0 healthy, 1 impaired; nominal 1), LVADConnected (0 disconnected, 1 connected; nominal 1), AssistControllerMode (0 PID, 1 sliding-mode; nominal 1), BaroreflexEnabled (0 disabled, 1 enabled; nominal 1), ResistanceVariationEnabled (0 constant systemic resistance, 1 dynamic resistance response; nominal 1), and ElastanceVariationEnabled (0 constant ventricular elastance limit, 1 autonomically varying elastance limit; nominal 1).
Each mode must act on the corresponding connected plant or feedback path and may not merely relabel an output.

functional_paths: AssistControlState, four columns [assist-device ejection pressure mmHg, controller effort, integrated absolute pressure error, time-weighted integrated absolute pressure error];
